name: JivoChat
line: Website chat and omnichannel inbox for customer messages and calls.

free.text: Free plan; agent cap conflicts between 2 and 5

cells.channels: Website chat, email, social, phone, SMS

agents.math: One agent fits both published free-seat limits, and conversations are unlimited.
The free limit is listed as two or five agents. The paid Basic plan for three agents is $120 a month.
